issue.title: redact: a short password after an English name in prose (password: abc12) is not masked
issue.body: Sibling of 714ab8e8b, which masks any value of 4+ after 密码/密碼/口令/パスワード/비밀번호. The English rule (SECRET, `password = …`) still asks for 8+ characters with letters and digits both, so "my password: abc12" in a message goes to the vendor as written. The bar is there because code calls many things a password (`password: String`, `password: str`), so a fix needs a way to tell prose from code (e.g. a natural-language marker like "is"/"my password", or notCode's context) and the leave-alone cases from rules_test kept green. Reported against the Chinese case by CyberCaius on Discord.

comments.body:
Re-checked on current upstream `b1e8eb15a668bbccfcd46977c75602ceaa4d66b3`. The English prose case was still unmasked: `my password: abc12` went through unchanged, while the Chinese named-password rule already accepted short values.

Fork branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3574-prose-password
Commit: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/5d1592b31a171761390c63a37ab21444ad9ae59e

The prose rule now masks a password after words such as `my password`, `your password:`, or `password is`, including a short value that contains a digit. Code names (`password: String`, `password = getPassword()`) and sentences with no value (`the password is required`) stay unchanged. The existing eight-character mixed rule remains for config-style assignments.

Verified:
- RED before the rule: `TestProsePasswordMasked` failed with 0 masked on every reported prose case.
- GREEN after: `go test -tags nogui ./internal/redact -count=1` passed (1.725s), and `go test -race -tags nogui ./internal/redact -count=1` passed (18.409s).
- Real gateway surface: `TestCampaign3574GatewayMasksProsePassword` posts to a local HTTP upstream through `/v1/chat/completions`; masking on sends a placeholder and masking off sends the literal text. It passed, including the race rerun.
- `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/redact ./internal/gateway`, `go build -tags nogui`, `gofmt -l`, and `git diff --check` passed.

Not tried: a real vendor account or the Settings preview UI in a browser. The gateway test exercises the actual request path; `/api/masking/preview` intentionally previews as if masking were on, so it is not the off-switch surface.
